game.name: Dirt 3 (USA, Europe)
game.desc: DiRT 3 is a racing game for Xbox 360. Take the wheel of one of the sixty vehicles available, including the Mini Cooper S1275 or the Lancia Stratos HF Integrale, and take part in one of the 6 game modes in single or split screen mode. Online multiplayer is also available, and new modes such as Gymkhana have been introduced.
